title: dump_sent
description: A person sent a dump. Emitted when the message is committed, not when it is answered, so the funnel separates dumping from being answered and a model outage shows as answers falling rather than dumps falling. 020 added the photo count, their byte size and whether they came through the share sheet: counts, a size and a boolean, never a name (OFF-1). 021 added whether a voice note came with it, its seconds as the device counted them, and its bytes: a boolean, a duration and a size. 026 added whether it arrived as a forwarded email: a boolean.
